cases.question: How do the waiting periods compare across the three plans?
cases.expected_answer: The waiting period is 90 days on Basic, 30 days on Standard and 14 days on Premium.
cases.answer: The Basic plan has a 90-day waiting period [1][2], the Standard plan has a 30-day waiting period [1][3], and the Premium plan has a 14-day waiting period [1][3]. Therefore, the Premium plan has the shortest waiting period, the Standard plan is intermediate, and the Basic plan has the longest [1]. In each plan, the waiting period applies from the policy start date before non-emergency treatment becomes eligible [3][2].
